mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 3% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) rises by > 0.5pp in 2 months, it signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and rising GDP (GDPC1) signals a strong supply side, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this interaction-driven mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A > 5% month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when RSAFS increases > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% and a CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase > 2% in 3 months signals tightening monetary policy and inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 35% of instances when both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of payroll employment (PAYEMS) is a persistent driver of S&P 500 returns, with higher employment levels leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns do not correlate significantly with PAYEMS levels (Pearson's r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a > 10% quarter-over-quarter increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong demand rebound, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of post-shock recovery instances when GDPC1 increases > 10% QoQ.
